params.unstakeDelaySec: - The unstake delay for this paymaster. Can only be increased.

params._pricePerEth: How many smallest-token-units equal 1 ETH.                     Example: ETH = $2 500, USDC (6 dec) → 2500 * 1e6 = 2_500_000_000

getHash((address,uint256,bytes,bytes,byt.details: Compute the hash the backend must sign.      Binds signature to: the exact UserOp fields, this paymaster, the token, and validity window.

returns._0: tokenAmount    Amount of token to charge.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.actualGasCost: - Actual gas used so far (without this postOp call).
params.actualUserOpFeePerGas: - the gas price this UserOp pays. This value is based on the UserOp's maxFeePerGas                        and maxPriorityFee (and basefee)                        It is not the same as tx.gasprice, which is what the bundler pays.
params.context: - The context value returned by validatePaymasterUserOp
params.mode: - Enum with the following options:                        opSucceeded - User operation succeeded.                        opReverted  - User op reverted. The paymaster still has to pay for gas.                        postOpReverted - never passed in a call to postOp().

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.maxCost: - The maximum cost of this transaction (based on maximum gas and gas price from userOp).
params.userOpHash: - Hash of the user's request data.

returns.context: - Value to send to a postOp. Zero length to signify postOp is not required.
returns.validationData: - Signature and time-range of this operation, encoded the same as the return                          value of validateUserOperation.                          <20-byte> sigAuthorizer - 0 for valid signature, 1 to mark signature failure,                                                    other values are invalid for paymaster.                          <6-byte> validUntil - last timestamp this operation is valid. 0 for "indefinite"                          <6-byte> validAfter - first timestamp this operation is valid                          Note that the validation code cannot use block.timestamp (or block.number) directly.

params.withdrawAddress: - The address to send withdrawn value.

addStake(uint32).notice: Add stake for this paymaster. This method can also carry eth value to add to the current stake.

configureToken(address,uint8,uint256).notice: Configure a token for gas payment.

deposit().notice: Add a deposit for this paymaster, used for paying for transaction fees.

getDeposit().notice: Return current paymaster's deposit on the entryPoint.

getTokenCostForGas(address,uint256).notice: Calculate token cost for a given native gas cost.

postOp(uint8,bytes,uint256,uint256).notice: Post-operation handler. Must verify sender is the entryPoint.

unlockStake().notice: Unlock the stake, in order to withdraw it. The paymaster can't serve requests once unlocked, until it calls addStake again

validatePaymasterUserOp((address,uint256.notice: Payment validation: check if paymaster agrees to pay. Must verify sender is the entryPoint. Revert to reject this request. Note that bundlers will reject this method if it changes the state, unless the paymaster is trusted (whitelisted). The paymaster pre-pays using its deposit, and receive back a refund after the postOp method returns.

verifyingSigner().notice: The trusted backend signer that authorizes UserOps.

withdrawStake(address).notice: Withdraw the entire paymaster's stake. stake must be unlocked first (and then wait for the unstakeDelay to be over)
